description: Ready-made custom criteria built from places on OpenStreetMap, with neutral descriptive names: kebab shops vs cafés, specialty coffee vs kebab shops, sandwich chains vs bakery chains, independent vs chain cafés, the nearest gym or sports centre, bars, pubs and clubs (more or fewer, per 1,000 residents), cinemas, theatres, museums and galleries, universities, the nearest playground or nursery, variety of cuisines, bakeries vs betting shops, takeaways, coworking, bike parking, the nearest EV charging point, the nearest market, the nearest dog park, vet or pet shop. Each has an id for evaluate_custom_criterion and find_areas(custom=[…]), a mapUrl (the map coloured by it) and a one-line definition. Use the names as given: no brand names or value words ('good', 'cheap') in what you tell the user. Coming soon: until Close Knit opens to assistants this tool answers status coming-soon, no data.
name: list_custom_presets
title: List custom presets
